description: A single-line text field for names, emails, phone numbers and other short data.

guidelines.label: Always put a label above the field (use Field + FieldLabel). A placeholder is not a label.
guidelines.error: On error, add aria-invalid and a red helper text that explains how to fix it.

withLabel.title: With Label
withLabel.description: Combine with Field, FieldLabel and FieldDescription.

invalid.title: Error
invalid.description: A 2px red border and a message that explains how to fix the value.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: A value that cannot be changed.

props.type: Kind of value: text, email, tel, password, number, file and more.
props.native: Input also accepts every native <input> attribute.
